def boot_ci(y, p, groups, gens, n=N_BOOT, seed=BOOT_SEED):
    rng = np.random.RandomState(seed)
    pg = {}
    for g in sorted(gens):
        m = groups == g

        for b in range(n):

                 "ci_upper": round(float(np.percentile(boots, 97.5)), 4)}

    rng2 = np.random.RandomState(seed + 1)
